_doc: Sledge's Tactical Breaching Hammer "The Caber" (research/operators/sledge.md §3; Phase 8 M4): his ability, the item in his slot 2 (Z). Fire swings it, 0.8 s a swing (Y11S3.1); the blow lands `use.hitS` into the swing and reaches `use.reachM` from his eye. Within `use.bothSkinsM` of a soft wall (across the floor; a floor hammered from above) it breaks both faces and the wooden studs, a rectangle `use.holeM` (width, height) round where he looks: one swing a hole to crouch or vault through, two (one low, one high) a hole to walk through; further away only the near face. Barricades and unreinforced hatches go in one; reinforced and hard surfaces don't, but the swing is still spent. An enemy body it hits dies (`use.killCharges` charges, Fandom's Breaching Hammer page); an enemy gadget it hits is destroyed as a blast destroys it; an ingredient is set off. It works on a rope. 25 charges (Fandom, Liquipedia), one for each swing that meets something. Its reach, hole, hit time, the kill's cost and its size are placeholders.
name: Breaching Hammer
